content:
In #39399, I give a definition for locally free sheaves of modules. I can think of a number of reasonable ways to define these so I want to make sure people agree on a definition before proving a bunch of stuff about it.

I defined a predicate IsLocallyFreeData on SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData saying that all the maps are isos. The other way I could see doing this is defining a new structure LocallyFreeData which contains the data of the local isomorphisms. This has the benefit that we could use ≅ instead of IsIso but after trying both I found the first approach works better.
